camps.title: Aho Ikibondo gikoreshwa
camps.subtitle: Inkambi n'aho impunzi zituye mu Rwanda bandika gusura abana.

red.title: Imirire mibi ikabije
red.action: Umujyanama w'ubuzima yohereza umwana kuvurwa uwo munsi. Ikibondo gishyira umwana mu bafite ibyago byinshi kandi kikamenyesha umuforomo.

yellow.title: Imirire mibi yoroheje
yellow.action: Umwana ahabwa indyo y'inyongera kandi akongera gupimwa ku gusura gukurikira. Ikibondo giteganya gukurikirana.

green.title: Nta mirire mibi
green.action: Umwana arakura neza. Umujyanama w'ubuzima akomeza gusura nk'uko bisanzwe.

muac.note: Ibipimo bya OMS ku bana bafite amezi 6 kugeza kuri 59. MUAC ni kimwe mu bipimo: kubyimba ibirenge n'ibiro ugereranyije n'uburebure nabyo birasuzumwa.

faq.title: Ibibazo abantu bakunze kubaza
faq.subtitle: Niba ikibazo cyawe kitarimo, baza umugenzuzi w'inkambi yawe.

notes.1: Yongera ibiro neza, hafi y'umurongo wo hagati.
notes.4: Ibiro byagabanutse kuva ku gusura guheruka. Ikibondo kimenyesha ko akeneye ubufasha, umujyanama w'ubuzima akamwohereza ku muforomo.
notes.5: Yahawe indyo y'inyongera nyuma yo koherezwa. Yongeye kwiyongera ibiro.
notes.6: Yagarutse hafi y'umurongo we wa mbere.

band.minus2toMedian: hagati ya −2 SD n'umurongo wo hagati
band.atOrAbove: ku murongo wo hagati cyangwa hejuru

growthChart.title: Ibiro by'umwana ku mbonerahamwe y'imikurire ya OMS
growthChart.desc: Umwana akurikira umurongo wo hagati kugeza ku kwezi kwa 6, akamanuka agana kuri −2 SD ku kwezi kwa 8, akoherezwa kwa muganga, maze akagaruka hafi y'umurongo wo hagati ku kwezi kwa 15.
growthChart.hint: Kanda ku gusura kuri iyi mbonerahamwe urebe ibyo umujyanama w'ubuzima yanditse.
growthChart.caption: Ibiro ugereranyije n'imyaka, abakobwa bafite amezi 0 kugeza kuri 24. Ni urugero; amabara akurikira hafi ibipimo by'imikurire bya OMS.

meta.homeDescription: Gukurikirana imirire n'ubuzima bw'abana mu nkambi z'impunzi mu Rwanda. Bifasha abajyanama b'ubuzima kumenya kare abana bafite ibyago by'imirire mibi.
meta.aboutDescription: Impamvu Ikibondo cyabayeho n'uko gifasha abakozi b'ubuzima mu nkambi z'impunzi mu Rwanda kumenya kare abana bafite imirire mibi.

error.title: Hari ikitagenze neza
error.body: Habaye ikosa ritunguranye. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa usubire ahabanza.

validation.identifierRequired: Imeyili cyangwa nimero ya telefoni birakenewe
validation.phoneMin: Nimero ya telefoni igomba kugira nibura imibare 10
validation.passwordMin: Ijambo ry'ibanga rigomba kugira nibura inyuguti 8

login.title: Murakaza neza
login.subtitle: Injira kuri konti yawe ya Ikibondo
login.invalid: Ibyo winjije si byo. Ongera ugerageze.

register.successBody: Konti yawe itegereje kwemezwa n'umugenzuzi w'inkambi cyangwa umuyobozi. Uzabona imeyili konti yawe imaze gukora.
register.title: Kwiyandikisha kw'umubyeyi / urera umwana
register.subtitle: Fungura konti yawe (itegereje kwemezwa).
register.staffNote: Uri umujyanama w'ubuzima, umuforomo cyangwa umugenzuzi? Saba umugenzuzi wawe cyangwa umuyobozi kugufungurira konti.

forgotPassword.enterIdentifier: Andika imeyili cyangwa nimero ukoresha winjira.
forgotPassword.sendFailed: Ntitwabashije kohereza kode ubu. Tegereza iminota mike wongere ugerageze.
forgotPassword.resetFailed: Ntitwabashije guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga. Reba kode wongere ugerageze.
forgotPassword.title: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga
forgotPassword.requestIntro: Turohereza kode y'imibare 6 kuri telefoni cyangwa imeyili ya konti yawe.
forgotPassword.codeSent: Niba hari konti ihuye na {identifier}, kode iri mu nzira. Irarangira mu minota 10.
forgotPassword.passwordHint: Nibura inyuguti 8. Irinde amagambo asanzwe n'izina ryawe.
forgotPassword.doneBody: Wasohowe kuri telefoni na mudasobwa zose. Injira ukoresheje ijambo ry'ibanga rishya.

setPassword.failed: Ntitwabashije kubika ijambo ry'ibanga. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa usabe umuforomo ihuza rishya.
setPassword.title: Hitamo ijambo ry'ibanga
setPassword.broken: Iri huza ntiryuzuye. Fungura ihuza ryose wabonye kuri SMS cyangwa imeyili, cyangwa usabe umuforomo irindi.
setPassword.intro: Umuforomo yagufunguriye konti ya Ikibondo. Hitamo ijambo ry'ibanga uzi wenyine. Iri huza rikora rimwe gusa.
setPassword.passwordHint: Nibura inyuguti 8. Irinde amagambo asanzwe n'izina ryawe.
setPassword.doneBody: Injira ukoresheje nimero ya telefoni (cyangwa imeyili) n'ijambo ry'ibanga umaze guhitamo.
